options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output.

options.name: test_case_base_dir
options.description: Base directory that test case files are located as specified in the O(test_case_file_prefix).

options.name: test_case_file_prefix
options.description: finds list of test case files where file names match specified prefix. must define a prefix to set/derived the test_case_id (e.g., '(prefix)(test_case_id)\.yml'). If child directories exist in O(test_case_base_dir), the `test_suite_id` is set to respective parent directory. the 'test_suite_id' is set using the parent directory for each test case file in the O(test_case_base_dir). See examples for more details.

options.name: test_case_file_regex
options.description: defines the pattern regex to find the list of test case var files. See examples for more details. if not set the derived value is set to '(test_case_file_prefix)*.yml'

options.name: test_case_id_capture_regex
options.description: defines the regex group capture pattern used to find the test case identifiers. See examples for more details. if not set the derived value is set to '(test_case_file_prefix)(.*?).yml'

options.name: test_junit_report_file
options.description: path where the test junit report file will be written/saved.

options.name: test_results
options.description: Specifies a dictionary of test result dicts. See examples where test_suites and test_cases contain dynamic keys

options.name: test_results_dir
options.description: Directory where the O(test_results_file) and O(test_junit_report_file) test results are stored.

options.name: test_results_file
options.description: Path to store test suite test results using internal YAML format.

options.name: test_suite_list
options.description: List of test suite directories located in the O(test_case_base_dir). Each test suite directory is set as the test_suite_id in the results dictionary
